question: The Galician fisheries sector – the largest in Europe – is grappling with an unprecedented crisis, as fuel prices rise in response to the ongoing war in the Middle East sparked by President Trump’s imperialist invasion. Many in the sector have had to moor their boats because the cost of going out to fish is greater than the value of catches they can collect during their working day.
If they moor their fleet, however, they do not receive any aid whatsoever. The resulting situation is untenable. In the light of this: 1.

Will the Commission consider measures to mitigate job losses and impact on the economy and wages, as it has done in other industrial sectors, to put fisheries on an equal footing by providing aid similar to that which other industrial sectors have received at times of crisis?
